title: PCSO Lotto Results: 3 bettors split P15-M Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot on Oct. 23
summary: Three bettors will split the P15-million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in Friday's draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said.

blocks.text: Three bettors will split the P15-million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in Friday's draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said.
The tickets were purchased from outlets in Laguna, Valenzuela, and Nueva Ecija.
Meanwhile, the P430,857,884.28 Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot remained unclaimed after no bettor matched the winning numbers 14-38-44-25-52-47. — VBL, GMA News
